# console-1.2 run memfree2: Free-memory counters checked against the heap walk
# np-player.txt written by 1.3.0 build console-kit (the kit's files are not old settings files: the stale-settings guard leaves them as they are)
# tier 1, group draw, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# MSC_VGX_VGL_MEMFREE (on, vitaGL 0028, the Galaxy port's free-memory fix): the free video memory the resolution ladder asks for comes from counters kept by vitaGL's allocator wrappers instead of a walk of the whole heap. =2 answers with the walked figure and compares: the '[mem] free-figure questions' line must show 0 differ (a few 'skipped' are fine) and the pool mask 0x3 or more (bit 0 video memory, bit 1 main RAM pool). Any 'free figure kept on the heap walk' line in the log means the start-up probes refused a pool (then the switch changes nothing there; send the line). Also read the [vitaGL] lines for 'MEMFREE pool' (a counted difference).
